title: Low Tide Signal
tagline: A quiet coastal signal from a flooded edge of the future.
atmosphere: Quiet mystery, abandoned infrastructure, and social unease.
description: On a flooded coast, abandoned infrastructure and an uneasy community set the stage for a quiet science-fiction mystery. The first story is in development.
worldPremise: Water has redrawn the edges of this coastal world. What remains—places, people, and the things they have left behind—forms the mystery at its heart.

homepage.hook: A flooded coast. Abandoned places. A quiet mystery at the water's edge.
